description: This file defines the 'DeletedMessages' class, which manages a set of deleted message keys, storing and retrieving them via local storage specific to a session.

classes.name: DeletedMessages
classes.description: A class to handle tracking of deleted message keys within a user session, with methods to add, restore, clear, load, and save the deleted message identifiers.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a DeletedMessages instance with a session key and loads existing deleted messages from storage.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a message key has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks a message key as deleted.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted message key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all tracked deleted message keys.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the set of deleted message keys from local storage.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current set of deleted message keys to local storage.
